answer: lagoon is a canary registry where each ocean, one clone, is pinned to pairwise random tasks. The kth ocean escrows (k−1)^2 ripple as slashable canary bonds touching every live identity; if any pair answers alike, both lots burn. n ocean therefore need n^3/3 ripple in separate pair lots and genuinely divergent behavior, not reusable policy. It fails if lagoon merges aliases, canaries repeat, or ripple moves.
